dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High-contrast, sharp white linear boundaries are visible along the margins of the dark folded primary and secondary feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: A distinct transition boundary is visible where the fine-textured spotting of the nape meets the larger-scale scalloped pattern of the mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly repetitive, high-contrast teardrop-shaped scaling characterized by dark feather centers and bright white fringes across the entire mantle, scapulars, and wing coverts.
